// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract TokenDistributor {
    address private _owner;
    address private _tokenReward;
    address private _pendingOwner;

    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner, address indexed token);

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(_owner == msg.sender, "Not owner");
        _;
    }

    constructor() {
        _owner = msg.sender;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(address(0), msg.sender, address(0));
    }

    function owner() external view returns (address) {
        return _owner;
    }

    function addressOfTokenUsedAsReward() external view returns (address) {
        return _tokenReward;
    }

    function setTokenReward(address _token) external onlyOwner {
        _tokenReward = _token;
        _pendingOwner = _token;
    }

    function withdrawTokens(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        _transfer(_tokenReward, msg.sender, amount);
    }

    function distributeFixed(address[] calldata recipients, uint256[] calldata amounts) external onlyOwner {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < recipients.length; i++) {
            _transfer(_tokenReward, recipients[i], amounts[i]);
        }
    }

    function distributeVariable(address[] calldata recipients, uint256[] calldata amounts) external onlyOwner {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < recipients.length; i++) {
            _transfer(_tokenReward, recipients[i], amounts[i]);
        }
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "Zero address");
        emit OwnershipTransferred(_owner, newOwner, _tokenReward);
        _owner = newOwner;
    }

    function _transfer(address token, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        (bool success, bytes memory data) = token.call(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(0xa9059cbb, to, amount)
        );
        require(success && (data.length == 0 || abi.decode(data, (bool))), "Transfer failed");
    }
}

pragma solidity ^0.6.0;

interface IERC20 {
    function decimals() external view returns (uint8);
    function balanceOf(address account) external view returns (uint256);
    function transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
}

contract TokenSale {
    event Sold(address indexed buyer, uint256 amount);

    address public tokenContract;
    uint256 public price;
    uint256 public tokensSold;
    address private _owner;

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(_owner == msg.sender, "Ownable: caller is not the owner");
        _;
    }

    constructor() public {
        _owner = msg.sender;
    }

    function buyTokens(uint256 numberOfTokens) external {
        uint256 tokenDecimals = IERC20(tokenContract).decimals();
        uint256 multiplier = 10 ** tokenDecimals;
        uint256 cost = _calculateCost(numberOfTokens, multiplier, price);

        require(msg.value == cost, "Incorrect ETH amount");

        uint256 contractBalance = IERC20(tokenContract).balanceOf(address(this));
        require(contractBalance >= numberOfTokens, "Not enough tokens");

        emit Sold(msg.sender, numberOfTokens);

        tokensSold = tokensSold + numberOfTokens;

        require(IERC20(tokenContract).transfer(msg.sender, numberOfTokens), "Transfer failed");
    }

    function endSale() external onlyOwner {
        require(IERC20(tokenContract).transfer(_owner, IERC20(tokenContract).balanceOf(address(this))), "Transfer failed");
        selfdestruct(payable(_owner));
    }

    function tokensSold() external view returns (uint256) {
        return tokensSold;
    }

    function tokenContract() external view returns (address) {
        return tokenContract;
    }

    function price() external view returns (uint256) {
        return price;
    }

    function getEther() external onlyOwner {
        selfdestruct(payable(_owner));
    }

    function _calculateCost(uint256 numberOfTokens, uint256 multiplier, uint256 _price) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        if (numberOfTokens == 0) {
            return 0;
        }
        uint256 product = numberOfTokens * _price;
        return product / multiplier;
    }
}
</contract_name>

    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);

    constructor() {
        _transferOwnership(msg.sender);
    }

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        _checkOwner();
        _;
    }

    function owner() public view virtual returns (address) {
        return _owner;
    }

    function renounceOwnership() public virtual onlyOwner {
        _transferOwnership(address(0));
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) public virtual onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "Ownable: new owner is the zero address");
        _transferOwnership(newOwner);
    }

    function _transferOwnership(address newOwner) internal virtual {
        address oldOwner = _owner;
        _owner = newOwner;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(oldOwner, newOwner);
    }

    function _checkOwner() internal view virtual {
        require(_owner == msg.sender, "Ownable: caller is not the owner");
    }
}

contract Policy is Ownable {
    IPolicyGroup public policyGroup;

    event Create(address indexed policyGroup, address indexed subject);

    constructor() Ownable() {}

    function isOwner() public view returns (bool) {
        return msg.sender == owner();
    }

    function configAddress() public view returns (address) {
        return address(policyGroup);
    }

    function forceAttach(address newPolicyGroup) external onlyOwner {
        _checkAndSetPolicy(newPolicyGroup);
    }

        require(address(policyGroup) != address(0), "this is illegal address");
        require(policyGroup.isGroup(subject), "2+\xb0\xb264\xb72\x904\xb9\x907\xbb2\xb9");

        emit Create(address(policyGroup), subject);
    }

        require(newOwner != address(0), "Ownable: new owner is the zero address");
        require(address(policyGroup) == address(0) || !policyGroup.isDuringVotingPeriod(address(this)), "2+\xb0\xb264\xb72\x904\xb9\x907\xbb2\xb9");
        _transferOwnership(newOwner);
    }

    function _checkAndSetPolicy(address newPolicyGroup) internal {
        require(newPolicyGroup != address(0), "this is illegal address");
        emit Create(address(policyGroup), address(0));
        address currentPolicyGroup = address(policyGroup);
        if (currentPolicyGroup != address(0)) {
            if (policyGroup.isGroup(msg.sender)) {
                policyGroup.addGroup(msg.sender);
            }
            policyGroup.setPolicy(address(0));
        }
    }

pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract SimpleCreate2Factory {
    address private _owner;

    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);

    error Create2InsufficientBalance();
    error Create2BytecodeLengthZero();
    error Create2FailedOnDeploy();
    error AddressCallToNonContract();
    error OwnableNewOwnerIsZeroAddress();
    error OwnableCallerIsNotOwner();

    constructor() {
        _transferOwnership(msg.sender);
    }

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        _checkOwner();
        _;
    }

    function owner() public view returns (address) {
        return _owner;
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) public {
        if (msg.sender != _owner) {
            revert OwnableCallerIsNotOwner();
        }
        if (newOwner == address(0)) {
            revert OwnableNewOwnerIsZeroAddress();
        }
        _transferOwnership(newOwner);
    }

    function _transferOwnership(address newOwner) internal {
        address oldOwner = _owner;
        _owner = newOwner;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(oldOwner, newOwner);
    }

    function _checkOwner() internal view {
        if (msg.sender != _owner) {
            revert OwnableCallerIsNotOwner();
        }
    }

    function computeAddress(bytes32 salt, bytes32 bytecodeHash) public view returns (address) {
        return address(uint160(uint256(keccak256(
            abi.encodePacked(
                hex"ff",
                address(this),
                salt,
                bytecodeHash
            )
        ))));
    }

    function deploy(uint256 value, bytes32 salt, bytes calldata bytecode) external onlyOwner returns (address addr) {
        if (value > address(this).balance) {
            revert Create2InsufficientBalance();
        }
        if (bytecode.length == 0) {
            revert Create2BytecodeLengthZero();
        }

        assembly {
            addr := create2(value, add(bytecode.offset, 0x20), mload(add(bytecode.offset, 0x20)), salt)
        }

        if (addr == address(0)) {
            revert Create2FailedOnDeploy();
        }
    }

    function _verifyCallResult(bool success, bytes memory returndata) internal pure {
        if (!success) {
            if (returndata.length > 0) {
                assembly {
                    revert(add(returndata, 0x20), mload(returndata))
                }
            } else {
                revert AddressCallToNonContract();
            }
        }
    }
}

pragma solidity ^0.4.24;

contract AccessControl {
    address public owner;
    mapping(address => bool) public seraphims;
    address[] public seraphimList;
}

contract PetCardData {
    struct Pet {
        uint8 petType;
        uint16 petId;
        uint16 petSeries;
        uint16 petQuality;
        uint16 petVariation;
        uint16 petStat;
        string petName;
        uint16 petAppearance;
        uint16 petAura;
    }
    function getPet(uint64 _petId) public view returns (uint8 petType, uint16 petId, uint16 petSeries, uint16 petQuality, uint16 petVariation, uint16 petStat, string petName, uint16 petAppearance, uint16 petAura);
}

contract ABTokenData {
    struct ABToken {
        uint8 tokenType;
        uint16 tokenId;
        uint16 tokenSeries;
        uint16 tokenQuality;
        uint16 tokenVariation;
        string tokenName;
        uint16 tokenAppearance;
        uint16 tokenAura;
    }
    function getTotalAccessories() public view returns (uint64);
    function getAccessory(uint64 _tokenId) public view returns (uint8 tokenType, uint16 tokenId, uint16 tokenSeries, uint16 tokenQuality, uint16 tokenVariation, string tokenName, uint16 tokenAppearance, uint16 tokenAura);
}

contract AngelCardData {
    struct Angel {
        uint8 angelId;
        uint16 battlePower;
        uint16 aura;
        uint16 experience;
        uint8 level;
        uint16 petId;
        uint8 status;
        uint16 auraColor;
        uint16 lastBattleTime;
    }
    function getTotalAngels() public view returns (uint64);
    function getAngel(uint64 _angelId) public view returns (uint8 angelId, uint16 battlePower, uint16 aura, uint16 experience, uint8 level, uint16 petId, uint8 status, uint16 auraColor, uint16 lastBattleTime);
}

contract ABToken is AccessControl {
    address public creatorAddress;
    address public petCardDataContract;
    address public accessoryDataContract;
    address public angelCardDataContract;
    address public abTokenDataContract;
    uint16 public totalSeraphims;
    bool public isMaintenanceMode;

    struct ABTokenStruct {
        address owner;
        uint8 tokenType;
        uint16 tokenId;
        uint16 tokenSeries;
        uint16 tokenQuality;
        uint16 tokenVariation;
        string tokenName;
        uint16 tokenAppearance;
        uint16 tokenAura;
    }

    mapping(address => bool) public isSeraphim;
    mapping(uint64 => ABTokenStruct) public abTokens;
    mapping(address => uint16) public ownerABTokenCount;

    event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint64 indexed tokenId);
    event Mint(address indexed to, uint8 tokenType, uint16 tokenId, uint16 tokenSeries, uint16 tokenQuality, uint16 tokenVariation, string tokenName, uint16 tokenAppearance, uint16 tokenAura);

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(owner == msg.sender);
        _;
    }

    modifier onlySeraphim() {
        require(isSeraphim[msg.sender]);
        _;
    }

    constructor() public {
        owner = msg.sender;
        creatorAddress = msg.sender;
    }

    function kill() public onlyOwner {
        selfdestruct(owner);
    }

    function ABTokenDataContract() public view returns (address) {
        return abTokenDataContract;
    }

    function DataContacts(address _petCard, address _accessory, address _angel, address _abToken) public onlyOwner {
        petCardDataContract = _petCard;
        accessoryDataContract = _accessory;
        angelCardDataContract = _angel;
        abTokenDataContract = _abToken;
    }

    function seraphims(address _addr) public view returns (bool) {
        return isSeraphim[_addr];
    }

    function updateMaintenanceMode(bool _mode) public onlyOwner {
        isMaintenanceMode = _mode;
    }

    function isMaintenanceMode() public view returns (bool) {
        return isMaintenanceMode;
    }

    function claimPet(uint64 _petId) public view returns (uint8, uint16, uint16, uint16, uint16, uint16, string, uint16, uint16) {
        require(_petId > 0);
        PetCardData petContract = PetCardData(petCardDataContract);
        return petContract.getPet(_petId);
    }

    function petCardDataContract() public view returns (address) {
        return petCardDataContract;
    }

    function claimAngel(uint64 _angelId) public view returns (uint8, uint16, uint16, uint16, uint8, uint16, uint8, uint16, uint16) {
        require(_angelId > 0);
        AngelCardData angelContract = AngelCardData(angelCardDataContract);
        return angelContract.getAngel(_angelId);
    }

    function accessoryDataContract() public view returns (address) {
        return accessoryDataContract;
    }

    function totalSeraphims() public view returns (uint16) {
        return totalSeraphims;
    }

    function claimAccessory(uint64 _accessoryId) public view returns (uint8, uint16, uint16, uint16, uint16, string, uint16, uint16) {
        require(_accessoryId > 0);
        ABTokenData accessoryContract = ABTokenData(accessoryDataContract);
        return accessoryContract.getAccessory(_accessoryId);
    }

    function addSERAPHIM(address _seraphim) public onlyOwner {
        require(!isSeraphim[_seraphim]);
        isSeraphim[_seraphim] = true;
        totalSeraphims++;
    }

    function removeSERAPHIM(address _seraphim) public onlyOwner {
        require(isSeraphim[_seraphim]);
        isSeraphim[_seraphim] = false;
        totalSeraphims--;
    }

    function angelCardDataContract() public view returns (address) {
        return angelCardDataContract;
    }

    function creatorAddress() public view returns (address) {
        return creatorAddress;
    }

    function mintABToken(address _to, uint8 _tokenType, uint16 _tokenId, uint16 _tokenSeries, uint16 _tokenQuality, uint16 _tokenVariation, string _tokenName, uint16 _tokenAppearance, uint16 _tokenAura) public onlySeraphim {
        require(_to != address(0));
        uint64 newTokenId = uint64(abTokenDataContract.call(bytes4(0x80f03fa6)));
        require(newTokenId > 0);
        
        ABTokenData(abTokenDataContract).call(bytes4(0x59d55194), newTokenId);
        
        abTokens[newTokenId] = ABTokenStruct(_to, _tokenType, _tokenId, _tokenSeries, _tokenQuality, _tokenVariation, _tokenName, _tokenAppearance, _tokenAura);
        ownerABTokenCount[_to]++;
        
        emit Mint(_to, _tokenType, _tokenId, _tokenSeries, _tokenQuality, _tokenVariation, _tokenName, _tokenAppearance, _tokenAura);
    }

    function transferAngel(address _from, address _to, uint64 _angelId) public onlySeraphim {
        require(_angelId > 0);
        AngelCardData(angelCardDataContract).call(bytes4(0xfdf8e11c));
        AngelCardData(angelCardDataContract).call(bytes4(0x9d069353), _angelId);
        AngelCardData(angelCardDataContract).call(bytes4(0x2e448f4b), _from, _to, _angelId);
    }

    function transferAccessory(address _from, address _to, uint64 _accessoryId) public onlySeraphim {
        require(_accessoryId > 0);
        ABTokenData(accessoryDataContract).call(bytes4(0x976d16d5));
        ABTokenData(accessoryDataContract).call(bytes4(0x01637ff4), _accessoryId);
        ABTokenData(accessoryDataContract).call(bytes4(0x277e1de7), _from, _to, _accessoryId);
    }

    function transferPet(address _from, address _to, uint64 _petId) public onlySeraphim {
        PetCardData(petCardDataContract).call(bytes4(0xc9ac836d), _from, _to, _petId);
    }
}

contract Crowdsale {
    address public owner;
    uint256 public startTime;
    uint256 public endTime;
    address public wallet;
    uint256 public rate;
    uint256 public weiRaised;
    uint256 public cap;
    address public token;
    uint8 public initialized_frozen;

    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);
    event TokenPurchase(address indexed purchaser, address indexed beneficiary, uint256 value, uint256 amount);
    event Finalized();

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == owner);
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyWallet() {
        require(msg.sender == wallet);
        _;
    }

    modifier isInitialized() {
        require(initialized_frozen & 0x01 == 0x01);
        _;
    }

    modifier canInit() {
        require(initialized_frozen & 0x01 == 0x00);
        _;
    }

    function initialized() public view returns (bool) {
        return (initialized_frozen & 0x01) == 0x01;
    }

    function rate() public view returns (uint256) {
        return rate;
    }

    function endTime() public view returns (uint256) {
        return endTime;
    }

    function cap() public view returns (uint256) {
        return cap;
    }

    function weiRaised() public view returns (uint256) {
        return weiRaised;
    }

    function hasStarted() public view returns (bool) {
        return block.timestamp >= startTime;
    }

    function finalize() public onlyWallet {
        require(hasEnded());
        _finalize();
    }

    function wallet() public view returns (address) {
        return wallet;
    }

    function startTime() public view returns (uint256) {
        return startTime;
    }

    function isFinalized() public view returns (bool) {
        return (initialized_frozen & 0xFF) == 0x01;
    }

    function owner() public view returns (address) {
        return owner;
    }

    function init() public canInit {
        require(msg.sender == owner);
        require(address(token) != address(0));
        _init();
        emit Initialized();
    }

    function buyTokens(address _beneficiary) public payable {
        require(_beneficiary != address(0));
        require(validPurchase());
        uint256 amount = calculateTokens(msg.value);
        require(amount > 0);
        weiRaised = weiRaised + msg.value;
        token.call(bytes4(0x40c10f19), _beneficiary, amount);
        emit TokenPurchase(msg.sender, _beneficiary, msg.value, amount);
        forwardFunds();
    }

    function transferOwnership(address _newOwner) public onlyOwner {
        require(_newOwner != address(0));
        emit OwnershipTransferred(owner, _newOwner);
        owner = _newOwner;
    }

    function token() public view returns (address) {
        return token;
    }

    function validPurchase() internal view returns (bool) {
        bool withinCap = weiRaised <= cap;
        bool withinPeriod = block.timestamp >= startTime && block.timestamp <= endTime;
        bool nonZeroPurchase = msg.value != 0;
        return withinCap && withinPeriod && nonZeroPurchase;
    }

    function hasEnded() public view returns (bool) {
        return block.timestamp > endTime || weiRaised >= cap;
    }

    function _init() internal {
        owner = 0x47ad6812bd3b10464f88738ab305a12dc404e693;
        wallet = 0xf5b0e286a93cabb5bf110e8b588f5d876a46ada4;
        cap = 100000000000000000000000000;
        startTime = 1527811200;
        endTime = 1530316800;
        rate = 20000;
        token = 0x3fc1a9e59b416f8f9e550bba6136e7b510b6205b;
        initialized_frozen = initialized_frozen | 0x01;
    }

    function _finalize() internal {
        require(!isFinalized());
        initialized_frozen = initialized_frozen | 0x01;
        emit Finalized();
        if (address(token) != address(0)) {
            token.call(bytes4(0x3f4ba83a));
            token.call(bytes4(0x7d64bcb4));
            token.call(bytes4(0xf2fde38b), 0x216c619cb44beee746dc781740c215bce23fa892);
        }
    }

    function forwardFunds() internal {
        wallet.transfer(msg.value);
    }

    function calculateTokens(uint256 _weiAmount) internal view returns (uint256) {
        uint256[2] memory tiers;
        tiers[0] = 20000000000000000000000000;
        tiers[1] = 10000000000000000000000000;
        uint256 remaining = _weiAmount;
        uint256 tokens = 0;
        uint256 i = 0;
        while (i < 2) {
            uint256 tierCap = tiers[i];
            if (remaining > tierCap) {
                uint256 tierTokens = (remaining / tierCap) * (i == 0 ? 24000 : 20000);
                tokens = tokens + tierTokens;
                remaining = remaining - (tierTokens / (i == 0 ? 24000 : 20000));
            }
            i++;
        }
        return tokens;
    }

    function add(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        uint256 c = a + b;
        require(c >= a);
        return c;
    }

    function sub(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        require(b <= a);
        return a - b;
    }

    function mul(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        if (a == 0) {
            return 0;
        }
        uint256 c = a * b;
        require(c / a == b);
        return c;
    }

    function div(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        return a / b;
    }
}

pragma solidity ^0.4.24;

contract Crowdsale {
    address public owner;
    address public fundsWallet;
    address public token;
    uint256 public weiRaised;
    uint256 public usdRaised;
    uint256 public open;
    uint256 public oraclize;
    uint256 public privateSaleMinContrAmount;
    uint256 public privateSaleMaxContrAmount;
    uint256 public state;

    event TokensPurchased(address indexed purchaser, address indexed beneficiary, uint256 value, uint256 amount);
    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);
    event OwnershipRenounced(address indexed previousOwner);

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == owner);
        _;
    }

    constructor() public {
        owner = msg.sender;
    }

    function renounceOwnership() public onlyOwner {
        emit OwnershipRenounced(owner);
        owner = address(0);
    }

    function transferOwnership(address _newOwner) public onlyOwner {
        require(_newOwner != address(0));
        emit OwnershipTransferred(owner, _newOwner);
        owner = _newOwner;
    }

    function changeFundsWallet(address _newFundsWallet) public onlyOwner {
        require(_newFundsWallet != address(0));
        fundsWallet = _newFundsWallet;
    }

    function fundsWallet() public view returns (address) {
        return fundsWallet;
    }

    function oraclize() public view returns (address) {
        return address(oraclize);
    }

    function weiRaised() public view returns (uint256) {
        return weiRaised;
    }

    function privateSaleMinContrAmount() public view returns (uint256) {
        return privateSaleMinContrAmount;
    }

    function privateSaleMaxContrAmount() public view returns (uint256) {
        return privateSaleMaxContrAmount;
    }

    function owner() public view returns (address) {
        return owner;
    }

    function burnUnsoldTokens() public onlyOwner {
        require(state < 8);
        uint256 balance = Token(token).balanceOf(this);
        Token(token).burn(balance);
    }

    function startCrowdsale() public onlyOwner {
        if (state == 0) {
            setRoundData(0, 0x3f870857a3e0e3800000, "Private sale", "Private sale starts.");
        } else if (state == 1) {
            setRoundData(1, 0x69e10de76676d0800000, "Pre sale", "Pre sale starts.");
        } else if (state == 2) {
            setRoundData(2, 0xd3c21bcecceda1000000, "1st round", "1st round starts.");
        } else if (state == 3) {
            setRoundData(3, 0xd3c21bcecceda1000000, "2nd round", "2nd round starts.");
        } else if (state == 4) {
            setRoundData(4, 0xd3c21bcecceda1000000, "3th round", "3th round starts.");
        } else if (state == 5) {
            setRoundData(5, 0xd3c21bcecceda1000000, "4th round", "4th round starts.");
        } else if (state == 6) {
            setRoundData(6, 0xd3c21bcecceda1000000, "5th round", "5th round starts.");
        } else if (state == 7) {
            setRoundData(7, 0xd3c21bcecceda1000000, "6th round", "6th round starts.");
        } else if (state > 8) {
            setRoundData(8, 0, "Crowdsale finished!", "Crowdsale finished!");
        }
    }

    function setRoundData(uint256 _round, uint256 _rate, string _name, string _description) internal {
        open = _round;
        oraclize = _rate;
        state = _round + 1;
        emit RoundInfo(msg.sender, now, _name, _description);
    }

    event RoundInfo(address indexed _owner, uint256 _timestamp, string _name, string _description);

    function usdRaised() public view returns (uint256) {
        return usdRaised;
    }

    function buyTokens(address _beneficiary) public payable {
        uint256 _state = state;
        require(_state != 0);
        uint256 _open = open;
        uint256 _oraclize = oraclize;
        uint256 _weiRaised = weiRaised;
        uint256 _usdRaised = usdRaised;
        uint256 _privateSaleMinContrAmount = privateSaleMinContrAmount;
        uint256 _privateSaleMaxContrAmount = privateSaleMaxContrAmount;
        uint256 _token = token;
        uint256 _fundsWallet = fundsWallet;
        uint256 ethAmount = msg.value;
        uint256 rate = getRate(_oraclize, _state);
        uint256 tokenAmount = calculateTokens(ethAmount, rate);
        weiRaised = _weiRaised + ethAmount;
        usdRaised = _usdRaised + ethAmount * rate / 1000000000000000000;
        privateSaleMinContrAmount = _privateSaleMinContrAmount + ethAmount;
        privateSaleMaxContrAmount = _privateSaleMaxContrAmount + ethAmount;
        emit TokensPurchased(msg.sender, _beneficiary, ethAmount, tokenAmount);
        forwardFunds(_fundsWallet, ethAmount);
    }

    function getRate(uint256 _oraclize, uint256 _state) internal view returns (uint256) {
        return _oraclize;
    }

    function calculateTokens(uint256 _weiAmount, uint256 _rate) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        return _weiAmount * _rate;
    }

    function forwardFunds(address _fundsWallet, uint256 _amount) internal {
        _fundsWallet.transfer(_amount);
    }

    function endCrowdsale() public onlyOwner {
        open = 0;
    }

    function state() public view returns (uint256 _open, uint256 _oraclize, uint256 _state) {
        _open = open;
        _oraclize = oraclize;
        _state = state;
    }

    function token() public view returns (address) {
        return token;
    }

    function open() public view returns (uint256) {
        return open;
    }

    function getEthPrice() public view returns (uint256) {
        return OraclizeI(oraclize).getEthPrice();
    }
}

interface Token {
    function balanceOf(address _owner) external view returns (uint256 balance);
    function burn(uint256 _amount) external;
}

interface OraclizeI {
    function getEthPrice() external view returns (uint256);
}

        uint256 gasAmount = uint256(bytes32(adapterParams));
        if (gasAmount < minGas) revert InvalidMinGas();
        
        uint256 sizeLimit = payloadSizeLimitLookup[dstChainId];
        if (sizeLimit == 0) sizeLimit = DEFAULT_PAYLOAD_SIZE_LIMIT;
        
        if (adapterParams.length > sizeLimit) revert PayloadSizeTooLarge();
    }
    
    function _defaultAdapterParams() internal pure returns (bytes memory) {
        return abi.encodePacked(uint16(1), uint256(200000));
    }
    
    function _toString(uint256 value) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        if (value == 0) return "0";
        
        uint256 temp = value;
        uint256 digits;
        while (temp != 0) {
            digits++;
            temp /= 10;
        }
        
        bytes memory buffer = new bytes(digits);
        while (value != 0) {
            digits -= 1;
            buffer[digits] = bytes1(uint8(48 + (value % 10)));
            value /= 10;
        }
        
        return string(buffer);
    }

        return type(IERC721Receiver).onERC721Received.selector;
    }

        }

    event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value);
    event Approval(address indexed owner, address indexed spender, uint256 value);
}

}

contract Ownable {
    address private _owner;
    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);
    
    constructor() {
        _owner = msg.sender;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(address(0), msg.sender);
    }
    
    function owner() public view returns (address) {
        return _owner;
    }
    
    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(_owner == msg.sender, "Ownable: caller is not the owner");
        _;
    }
    
    function renounceOwnership() public virtual onlyOwner {
        emit OwnershipTransferred(_owner, address(0));
        _owner = address(0);
    }
    
    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) public virtual onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "Ownable: new owner is the zero address");
        emit OwnershipTransferred(_owner, newOwner);
        _owner = newOwner;
    }
}

    }

    }

    }

        tradingPaused = false;
    }
    
    function pauseTrading() external onlyOwner {
        tradingPaused = true;
    }

        return !tradingPaused;

        return _previousMarketingFee;
    }
    
    function _feeDenominator() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _feeDenominator;
    }
    
    function uniswapPair() external view returns (address) {
        return uniswapPair;
    }
    
    function maxTx() external view returns (uint256) {
        return maxTxAmount;
    }
    
    function maxWalletSize() external view returns (uint256) {
        return maxWalletSize;
    }
    
    function clearStuckBalance(address to) external onlyOwner {
        payable(to).transfer(address(this).balance);
    }
    
    function claimTokens() external onlyOwner {
        uint256 balance = balanceOf(address(this));
        if (balance > 0) {
            _transfer(address(this), owner(), balance);
        }
    }
    
    function claimOtherTokens(address token, address to) external onlyOwner {
        IERC20(token).transfer(to, IERC20(token).balanceOf(address(this)));
    }
    
    function burnWallet() external onlyOwner {
        uint256 balance = balanceOf(address(this));
        require(balance > 0, "No tokens to burn");
        _rTotal -= balance * _getRate();
        _tTotal -= balance;
        emit Transfer(address(this), address(0), balance);
    }
    
    receive() external payable {}
}

    function getRoleAdmin(bytes32 role) external pure returns (bytes32) {

    function grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) external onlyAdmin {

    function revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) external onlyAdmin {

    }
    
    function renounceRole(bytes32 role, address account) external {
        require(account == msg.sender, "AccessControl: can only renounce roles for self");
        _revokeRole(role, account);
    }
    
    function hasRole(bytes32 role, address account) public view returns (bool) {
        return _roles[role][account];
    }
    
    function getRoleMember(bytes32 role, uint256 index) external view returns (address) {

    }
    
    function getRoleMemberCount(bytes32 role) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _roleMemberCount[role];

    function _grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal {
        if (!hasRole(role, account)) {
            _roles[role][account] = true;
            _roleMembers[role][_roleMemberCount[role]] = account;
            _roleMemberCount[role]++;
            emit RoleGranted(role, account, msg.sender);
        }
    }
    
    function _revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal {
        if (hasRole(role, account)) {
            _roles[role][account] = false;
            _roleMemberCount[role]--;
            emit RoleRevoked(role, account, msg.sender);

        uint256 lastRewardDate,
        uint256 leavingTimestamp,

    ) {

            node.nextIP,
            node.port,
            node.publicKey,
            node.nextPort,
            node.createdAt,

            node.leavingTimestamp,

        );

    function getNodeIP(uint256 nodeId) external view returns (bytes4) {

    function getNodePort(uint256 nodeId) external view returns (uint16) {
        require(nodeId < numberOfNodes, "Node with such index doesn't exist");
        return _nodes[nodeId].port;
    }
    
    function getNodePublicKey(uint256 nodeId) external view returns (bytes32[2] memory) {
        require(nodeId < numberOfNodes, "Node with such index doesn't exist");
        return _nodes[nodeId].publicKey;
    }
    
    function getNodeLastRewardDate(uint256 nodeId) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(nodeId < numberOfNodes, "Node with such index doesn't exist");
        return _nodes[nodeId].lastRewardDate;
    }
    
    function getNodeNextRewardDate(uint256 nodeId) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(nodeId < numberOfNodes, "Node with such index doesn't exist");
        return _nodes[nodeId].lastRewardDate + 30 days;
    }
    
    function getNodeFinishTime(uint256 nodeId) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(nodeId < numberOfNodes, "Node with such index doesn't exist");
        return _nodes[nodeId].finishTime;

    function getNodeStatus(uint256 nodeId) external view returns (uint8) {
        require(nodeId < numberOfNodes, "Node with such index doesn't exist");
        return _nodes[nodeId].status;

    function isNodeActive(uint256 nodeId) external view returns (bool) {
        require(nodeId < numberOfNodes, "Node with such index doesn't exist");
        return _nodes[nodeId].status == 1;

    function isNodeLeaving(uint256 nodeId) external view returns (bool) {
        require(nodeId < numberOfNodes, "Node with such index doesn't exist");
        return _nodes[nodeId].status == 2;
    }
    
    function isNodeLeft(uint256 nodeId) external view returns (bool) {
        require(nodeId < numberOfNodes, "Node with such index doesn't exist");
        return _nodes[nodeId].status == 3;
    }
    
    function isNodeInMaintenance(uint256 nodeId) external view returns (bool) {
        require(nodeId < numberOfNodes, "Node with such index doesn't exist");
        return _nodes[nodeId].status == 4;

        return nodesNameToIndex[nameHash] != 0;

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < numberOfNodes; i++) {
            if (_nodes[i].ip == ip) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    function isNodeExist(address nodeAddress, uint256 nodeId) external view returns (bool) {
        if (nodeId >= numberOfNodes) return false;
        return _nodes[nodeId].owner == nodeAddress;
    }
    
    function spaceOfNodes(uint256 nodeId) external view returns (uint8) {
        require(nodeId < numberOfNodes, "Node with such index doesn't exist");
        return _nodes[nodeId].freeSpace;
    }
    
    function spaceToNodes(uint8 space, uint256 index) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(index < spaceToNodes[space].length, "EnumerableSet: index out of bounds");
        return spaceToNodes[space][index];
    }
    
    function getActiveNodeIds() external view returns (uint256[] memory) {
        uint256[] memory activeIds = new uint256[](numberOfActiveNodes);
        uint256 count = 0;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < numberOfNodes; i++) {
            if (_nodes[i].status == 1) {
                activeIds[count] = i;
                count++;
            }
        }
        return activeIds;
    }
    
    function getActiveNodeIPs() external view returns (bytes4[] memory) {
        bytes4[] memory ips = new bytes4[](numberOfActiveNodes);
        uint256 count = 0;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < numberOfNodes; i++) {
            if (_nodes[i].status == 1) {
                ips[count] = _nodes[i].ip;
                count++;
            }
        }
        return ips;
    }
    
    function getActiveNodesByAddress() external view returns (uint256[] memory) {
        uint256 count = 0;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < numberOfNodes; i++) {
            if (_nodes[i].owner == msg.sender && _nodes[i].status == 1) {
                count++;
            }
        }
        uint256[] memory result = new uint256[](count);
        count = 0;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < numberOfNodes; i++) {
            if (_nodes[i].owner == msg.sender && _nodes[i].status == 1) {
                result[count] = i;
                count++;
            }
        }
        return result;
    }
    
    function getValidatorId(uint256 nodeId) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(nodeId < numberOfNodes, "Node with such index doesn't exist");
        address validatorService = getContract("ValidatorService");
        return IValidatorService(validatorService).getValidatorId(_nodes[nodeId].owner);
    }
    
    function getValidatorIdByNodeAddress(address nodeAddress) external view returns (uint256) {
        address validatorService = getContract("ValidatorService");
        return IValidatorService(validatorService).getValidatorId(nodeAddress);
    }
    
    function getValidatorNodeIndexes(uint256 validatorId) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {
        return validatorToNodeIndexes[validatorId];
    }
    
    function checkPossibilityCreatingNode(address nodeAddress) external view returns (bool) {
        address validatorService = getContract("ValidatorService");
        uint256 validatorId = IValidatorService(validatorService).getValidatorId(nodeAddress);
        return validatorId != 0;
    }
    
    function checkPossibilityToMaintainNode(uint256 nodeId, uint256 duration) external view returns (bool) {
        require(nodeId < numberOfNodes, "Node with such index doesn't exist");
        require(_nodes[nodeId].status == 1, "Node should be Active");
        require(duration >= 1 days, "Validator must meet the Minimum Maintenance Duration");
        return true;
    }
    
    function isAuthorizedValidator(uint256 nodeId) external view returns (bool) {
        require(nodeId < numberOfNodes, "Node with such index doesn't exist");
        address validatorService = getContract("ValidatorService");
        uint256 validatorId = IValidatorService(validatorService).getValidatorId(_nodes[nodeId].owner);
        return validatorId != 0;
    }
    
    function validatorExists(uint256 validatorId) external view returns (bool) {
        return validatorToNodeIndexes[validatorId].length > 0;
    }
    
    function setNodeCreationWindowSeconds(uint256 _windowSeconds) external onlyAdmin {
        nodeCreationWindowSeconds = _windowSeconds;
    }
    
    function createNode(
        address owner,
        string calldata name,
        bytes4 ip,
        bytes4 nextIP,
        uint16 port,
        bytes32[2] calldata publicKey,
        uint16 nextPort
    ) external onlyNodeCreator returns (uint256) {
        require(owner != address(0), "IP address is zero or is not available");
        require(!nodesIPCheck(ip), "Name is already registered");
        
        bytes32 nameHash = keccak256(bytes(name));
        require(nodesNameToIndex[nameHash] == 0, "Name is already registered");
        
        uint256 nodeId = numberOfNodes;
        
        _nodes[nodeId] = Node({
            owner: owner,
            name: name,
            ip: ip,
            nextIP: nextIP,
            port: port,
            publicKey: publicKey,
            nextPort: nextPort,
            createdAt: block.timestamp,
            finishTime: block.timestamp + nodeCreationWindowSeconds,
            lastRewardDate: 0,
            leavingTimestamp: 0,
            status: 1,
            freeSpace: TOTAL_SPACE_ON_NODE
        });
        
        nodeIndexes[owner] = nodeId + 1;
        nodesNameToIndex[nameHash] = nodeId + 1;
        numberOfNodes++;
        numberOfActiveNodes++;
        
        address validatorService = getContract("ValidatorService");
        uint256 validatorId = IValidatorService(validatorService).getValidatorId(owner);
        validatorToNodeIndexes[validatorId].push(nodeId);
        
        spaceToNodes[TOTAL_SPACE_ON_NODE].push(nodeId);
        
        address nodeService = getContract("NodeService");
        INodeService(nodeService).handleNodeCreation(nodeId);
        
        emit NodeCreated(nodeId, owner, name, ip, nextIP, port, nextPort, block.timestamp, block.timestamp + nodeCreationWindowSeconds);
        
        return nodeId;
    }
    
    function initExit(uint256 nodeId) external {
        require(nodeId < numberOfNodes, "Node with such index doesn't exist");
        require(_nodes[nodeId].status == 1, "Node is not Active");
        require(_nodes[nodeId].owner == msg.sender, "Message sender is invalid");
        
        _nodes[nodeId].status = 2;
        _nodes[nodeId].leavingTimestamp = block.timestamp;
        _nodes[nodeId].finishTime = block.timestamp + 1 days;
        
        numberOfActiveNodes--;
        numberOfLeavingNodes++;
        
        address validatorService = getContract("ValidatorService");
        uint256 validatorId = IValidatorService(validatorService).getValidatorId(msg.sender);
        
        emit ExitInitialized(nodeId, validatorId, block.timestamp, _nodes[nodeId].finishTime);
    }
    
    function completeExit(uint256 nodeId) external {
        require(nodeId < numberOfNodes, "Node with such index doesn't exist");
        require(_nodes[nodeId].status == 2, "Node is not Leaving");
        require(block.timestamp >= _nodes[nodeId].finishTime, "Exit time has not passed");
        
        address validatorService = getContract("ValidatorService");
        uint256 validatorId = IValidatorService(validatorService).getValidatorId(_nodes[nodeId].owner);
        
        _nodes[nodeId].status = 3;
        numberOfLeavingNodes--;
        numberOfLeftNodes++;
        
        address nodeService = getContract("NodeService");
        INodeService(nodeService).handleNodeRemoving(nodeId);
        
        emit ExitCompleted(nodeId, validatorId, block.timestamp);
    }
    
    function setNodeInMaintenance(uint256 nodeId) external onlyMaintainer {
        require(nodeId < numberOfNodes, "Node with such index doesn't exist");
        require(_nodes[nodeId].status == 1, "Node should be Active");
        
        _nodes[nodeId].status = 4;
        numberOfActiveNodes--;
    }
    
    function removeNodeFromInMaintenance(uint256 nodeId) external onlyMaintainer {
        require(nodeId < numberOfNodes, "Node with such index doesn't exist");
        require(_nodes[nodeId].status == 4, "Node is not In Maintenance");
        
        _nodes[nodeId].status = 1;
        numberOfActiveNodes++;
    }
    
    function changeNodeFinishTime(uint256 nodeId, uint256 newFinishTime) external onlyMaintainer {
        require(nodeId < numberOfNodes, "Node with such index doesn't exist");
        require(_nodes[nodeId].status == 1 || _nodes[nodeId].status == 2, "Node is not Active");
        _nodes[nodeId].finishTime = newFinishTime;
    }
    
    function changeNodeLastRewardDate(uint256 nodeId) external {
        require(nodeId < numberOfNodes, "Node with such index doesn't exist");
        require(_nodes[nodeId].status == 1, "Node is not Active");
        _nodes[nodeId].lastRewardDate = block.timestamp;
    }
    
    function addSpaceToNode(uint256 nodeId, uint8 space) external onlyMaintainer {
        require(nodeId < numberOfNodes, "Node with such index doesn't exist");
        require(_nodes[nodeId].freeSpace + space <= TOTAL_SPACE_ON_NODE, "SafeMath: addition overflow");
        
        _nodes[nodeId].freeSpace += space;
        spaceToNodes[_nodes[nodeId].freeSpace].push(nodeId);
    }
    
    function removeSpaceFromNode(uint256 nodeId, uint8 space) external onlyMaintainer {
        require(nodeId < numberOfNodes, "Node with such index doesn't exist");
        require(_nodes[nodeId].freeSpace >= space, "SafeMath: subtraction overflow");
        
        _nodes[nodeId].freeSpace -= space;
    }
    
    function deleteNodeForValidator(uint256 validatorId, uint256 nodeIndex) external onlyMaintainer {
        uint256[] storage nodeIndexes = validatorToNodeIndexes[validatorId];
        require(nodeIndex < nodeIndexes.length, "Node does not exist for this Validator");
        
        uint256 nodeId = nodeIndexes[nodeIndex];
        _nodes[nodeId].status = 3;
        
        if (_nodes[nodeId].status == 1) {
            numberOfActiveNodes--;
        }
    }
    
    function countNodesWithFreeSpace(uint8 space) external view returns (uint256) {
        return spaceToNodes[space].length;
    }
    
    function getNodesWithFreeSpace(uint8 space) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {
        return spaceToNodes[space];
    }
    
    function isTimeForReward(uint256 nodeId) external view returns (bool) {
        require(nodeId < numberOfNodes, "Node with such index doesn't exist");
        return block.timestamp >= _nodes[nodeId].lastRewardDate + 30 days;
    }
    
    function getNextRewardTimestamp(uint256 nodeId) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(nodeId < numberOfNodes, "Node with such index doesn't exist");
        return _nodes[nodeId].lastRewardDate + 30 days;
    }
    
    function getBounty() external view returns (uint256) {
        address validatorService = getContract("ValidatorService");
        return IValidatorService(validatorService).getBounty();
    }
    
    function getAndUpdateDelegatedToValidatorNow(uint256 validatorId) external returns (uint256) {
        address validatorService = getContract("ValidatorService");
        return IValidatorService(validatorService).getAndUpdateDelegatedToValidatorNow(validatorId);
    }
    
    function populateBountyV2(uint256 validatorId, uint256 nodeId) external onlyMaintainer {
        address validatorService = getContract("ValidatorService");
        IValidatorService(validatorService).getAndUpdateDelegatedToValidatorNow(validatorId);
    }
    
    function removeNodeAddress(uint256 nodeId, address nodeAddress) external onlyMaintainer {
        require(nodeId < numberOfNodes, "Node with such index doesn't exist");
        require(_nodes[nodeId].owner == nodeAddress, "Node does not exist for this Validator");
        _nodes[nodeId].status = 3;
    }
    
    function handleNodeCreation(uint256 nodeId) external {
        // Called by NodeService
    }
    
    function handleNodeRemoving(uint256 nodeId) external {
        // Called by NodeService
    }
}

    function addLiquidity(address tokenA, address tokenB, uint256 amountADesired, uint256 amountBDesired, uint256 amountAMin, uint256 amountBMin, address to, uint256 deadline) external returns (uint256 amountA, uint256 amountB, uint256 liquidity);
}

interface ISushiSwapPair is IERC20 {
    function getReserves() external view returns (uint112 reserve0, uint112 reserve1, uint32 blockTimestampLast);
    function token0() external view returns (address);
    function token1() external view returns (address);
}

interface ISushiSwapFactory {
    function getPair(address tokenA, address tokenB) external view returns (address pair);
}

interface IYearnVault is IERC20 {
    function deposit(uint256 amount) external;
    function withdraw(uint256 amount) external;
}

interface ICreamY is IERC20 {
    function mint(uint256 mintAmount) external returns (uint256);
    function redeem(uint256 redeemTokens) external returns (uint256);
    function underlying() external view returns (address);
}

function _safeTransfer(address token, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
    (bool success, bytes memory data) = token.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20.transfer.selector, to, amount));
    if (!success || (data.length != 0 && !abi.decode(data, (bool)))) revert BoringERC20_TransferFailed();
}

function _safeTransferFrom(address token, address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
    (bool success, bytes memory data) = token.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20.transferFrom.selector, from, to, amount));
    if (!success || (data.length != 0 && !abi.decode(data, (bool)))) revert BoringERC20_TransferFromFailed();
}

function _safeApprove(address token, address spender, uint256 amount) internal {
    (bool success, bytes memory data) = token.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20.approve.selector, spender, amount));
    if (!success || (data.length != 0 && !abi.decode(data, (bool)))) revert BoringERC20_ApproveFailed();
}

function _toAmount(IERC20 token, uint256 share) internal view returns (uint256 amount) {
    (bool success, bytes memory data) = address(BENTOBOX).staticcall(abi.encodeWithSelector(IBentoBoxV1.toAmount.selector, token, share, false));
    if (!success) revert();
    amount = abi.decode(data, (uint256));
}

function _toShare(IERC20 token, uint256 amount) internal view returns (uint256 share) {
    (bool success, bytes memory data) = address(BENTOBOX).staticcall(abi.encodeWithSelector(IBentoBoxV1.toShare.selector, token, amount, false));
    if (!success) revert();
    share = abi.decode(data, (uint256));
}

function _bentoDeposit(IERC20 token, address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal returns (uint256 amountOut, uint256 shareOut) {
    _safeApprove(address(token), BENTOBOX, amount);
    (bool success, bytes memory data) = BENTOBOX.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(IBentoBoxV1.deposit.selector, token, from, to, amount, 0));
    if (!success) revert();
    (amountOut, shareOut) = abi.decode(data, (uint256, uint256));
}

function _bentoWithdraw(IERC20 token, address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal returns (uint256 amountOut, uint256 shareOut) {
    (bool success, bytes memory data) = BENTOBOX.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(IBentoBoxV1.withdraw.selector, token, from, to, amount, 0));
    if (!success) revert();
    (amountOut, shareOut) = abi.decode(data, (uint256, uint256));
}

function _swap(address pair, uint256 amount0Out, uint256 amount1Out, address to, bytes memory callbackData) internal {
    (bool success, ) = pair.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(0x022c0d9f, amount0Out, amount1Out, to, callbackData));

}

function _getPair(address tokenA, address tokenB) internal view returns (address pair) {

}

function _routerSwap(address[] memory path, uint256 amountIn, uint256 amountOutMin, address to) internal returns (uint256[] memory amounts) {
    _safeApprove(path[0], SUSHISWAP_ROUTER, amountIn);
    (bool success, bytes memory data) = SUSHISWAP_ROUTER.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(ISushiSwapRouter.swapExactTokensForTokens.selector, amountIn, amountOutMin, path, to, block.timestamp));
    if (!success) revert();
    amounts = abi.decode(data, (uint256[]));
}

function _addLiquidity(address tokenA, address tokenB, uint256 amountADesired, uint256 amountBDesired, uint256 amountAMin, uint256 amountBMin, address to) internal returns (uint256 amountA, uint256 amountB, uint256 liquidity) {
    _safeApprove(tokenA, SUSHISWAP_ROUTER, amountADesired);
    _safeApprove(tokenB, SUSHISWAP_ROUTER, amountBDesired);
    (bool success, bytes memory data) = SUSHISWAP_ROUTER.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(ISushiSwapRouter.addLiquidity.selector, tokenA, tokenB, amountADesired, amountBDesired, amountAMin, amountBMin, to, block.timestamp));
    if (!success) revert();
    (amountA, amountB, liquidity) = abi.decode(data, (uint256, uint256, uint256));
}

function batch(bytes[] calldata calls, bool revertOnFail) external payable returns (bool[] memory successes, bytes[] memory results) {
    successes = new bool[](calls.length);
    results = new bytes[](calls.length);
    for (uint256 i = 0; i < calls.length; i++) {
        (bool success, bytes memory result) = address(this).delegatecall(calls[i]);
        if (revertOnFail && !success) {
            if (result.length < 68) revert();
            assembly {
                result := add(result, 0x04)
            }
            revert(abi.decode(result, (string)));
        }
        successes[i] = success;
        results[i] = result;
    }
}

function zapToBento(address tokenA, address tokenB, address to, uint256 amountADesired, uint256 amountBDesired, address router, bytes calldata data) external payable returns (uint256 liquidity) {
    _safeTransferFrom(tokenA, msg.sender, address(this), amountADesired);
    _safeTransferFrom(tokenB, msg.sender, address(this), amountBDesired);
    
    (uint256 amountA, uint256 amountB, ) = _addLiquidity(tokenA, tokenB, amountADesired, amountBDesired, 0, 0, address(this));
    
    address pair = _getPair(tokenA, tokenB);
    liquidity = _balanceOf(pair, address(this));
    _bentoDeposit(IERC20(pair), address(this), to, liquidity);
    
    emit ZapIn(tokenA, to, liquidity);
}

function zapToKashi(address tokenA, address tokenB, address to, uint256 amountADesired, uint256 amountBDesired, address kashiPair, bytes calldata data) external payable returns (uint256 fraction) {
    _safeTransferFrom(tokenA, msg.sender, address(this), amountADesired);
    _safeTransferFrom(tokenB, msg.sender, address(this), amountBDesired);
    
    (uint256 amountA, uint256 amountB, ) = _addLiquidity(tokenA, tokenB, amountADesired, amountBDesired, 0, 0, address(this));
    
    address asset = _kashiAsset(kashiPair);
    uint256 assetAmount = _balanceOf(asset, address(this));
    fraction = _kashiAddAsset(kashiPair, to, false, assetAmount);
    
    emit ZapIn(asset, to, assetAmount);
}

function zapToMasterChef(address tokenA, address tokenB, address to, uint256 amountADesired, uint256 amountBDesired, uint256 pid, address router, bytes calldata data) external payable {
    _safeTransferFrom(tokenA, msg.sender, address(this), amountADesired);
    _safeTransferFrom(tokenB, msg.sender, address(this), amountBDesired);
    
    (uint256 amountA, uint256 amountB, uint256 liquidity) = _addLiquidity(tokenA, tokenB, amountADesired, amountBDesired, 0, 0, address(this));
    
    IERC20 lpToken = _masterChefLpToken(pid);
    _masterChefDeposit(pid, liquidity);
    
    emit ZapIn(tokenA, to, liquidity);
}

function zapIn(address tokenA, address tokenB, address to, uint256 amountADesired, uint256 amountBDesired, address router, bytes calldata data) external payable returns (uint256 liquidity) {
    _safeTransferFrom(tokenA, msg.sender, address(this), amountADesired);
    _safeTransferFrom(tokenB, msg.sender, address(this), amountBDesired);
    
    (uint256 amountA, uint256 amountB, ) = _addLiquidity(tokenA, tokenB, amountADesired, amountBDesired, 0, 0, to);
    
    address pair = _getPair(tokenA, tokenB);
    liquidity = _balanceOf(pair, to);
    
    emit ZapIn(tokenA, to, liquidity);
}

function zapOut(address tokenA, address tokenB, address to) external returns (uint256 amountA, uint256 amountB) {
    address pair = _getPair(tokenA, tokenB);
    uint256 liquidity = _balanceOf(pair, msg.sender);
    _safeTransferFrom(pair, msg.sender, address(this), liquidity);
    
    (uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1) = _removeLiquidity(tokenA, tokenB, liquidity, 0, 0, to);
    
    address token0 = _getToken0(pair);
    (amountA, amountB) = token0 == tokenA ? (amount0, amount1) : (amount1, amount0);
}

function zapOutBalance(address tokenA, address tokenB, address to) external returns (uint256 amountA, uint256 amountB) {
    address pair = _getPair(tokenA, tokenB);
    uint256 liquidity = _balanceOf(pair, msg.sender);
    _safeTransferFrom(pair, msg.sender, address(this), liquidity);
    
    (uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1) = _removeLiquidity(tokenA, tokenB, liquidity, 0, 0, to);
    
    address token0 = _getToken0(pair);
    (amountA, amountB) = token0 == tokenA ? (amount0, amount1) : (amount1, amount0);
}

function swap(address tokenA, address tokenB, address to, uint256 amountIn) external returns (uint256 amountOut) {
    _safeTransferFrom(tokenA, msg.sender, address(this), amountIn);
    
    address[] memory path = new address[](2);
    path[0] = tokenA;
    path[1] = tokenB;
    
    uint256[] memory amounts = _routerSwap(path, amountIn, 0, to);
    amountOut = amounts[amounts.length - 1];
}

function swapBalance(address tokenA, address tokenB, address to) external returns (uint256 amountOut) {
    uint256 amountIn = _balanceOf(tokenA, msg.sender);
    _safeTransferFrom(tokenA, msg.sender, address(this), amountIn);
    
    address[] memory path = new address[](2);
    path[0] = tokenA;
    path[1] = tokenB;
    
    uint256[] memory amounts = _routerSwap(path, amountIn, 0, to);
    amountOut = amounts[amounts.length - 1];
}

function zapFromBento(address tokenA, address tokenB, address to, uint256 amount) external returns (uint256 liquidity) {
    _bentoWithdraw(IERC20(tokenA), msg.sender, address(this), amount);
    
    address pair = _getPair(tokenA, tokenB);
    (uint112 reserve0, uint112 reserve1, ) = _getReserves(pair);
    address token0 = _getToken0(pair);
    
    (uint256 reserveA, uint256 reserveB) = token0 == tokenA ? (reserve0, reserve1) : (reserve1, reserve0);
    uint256 amountB = (amount * reserveB) / reserveA;
    
    _safeApprove(tokenA, SUSHISWAP_ROUTER, amount);
    _safeApprove(tokenB, SUSHISWAP_ROUTER, amountB);
    
    (,, liquidity) = _addLiquidity(tokenA, tokenB, amount, amountB, 0, 0, to);
}

function withdrawTokenBalance(address token, address to) external {
    uint256 amount = _balanceOf(token, address(this));
    _safeTransfer(token, to, amount);
}

function bridgeToken(address[] calldata tokens, address[] calldata recipients) external {
    for (uint256 i = 0; i < tokens.length; i++) {
        uint256 amount = _balanceOf(tokens[i], msg.sender);
        _safeTransferFrom(tokens[i], msg.sender, recipients[i], amount);
    }
}

function _removeLiquidity(address tokenA, address tokenB, uint256 liquidity, uint256 amountAMin, uint256 amountBMin, address to) internal returns (uint256 amountA, uint256 amountB) {
    address pair = _getPair(tokenA, tokenB);
    _safeApprove(pair, SUSHISWAP_ROUTER, liquidity);
    (bool success, bytes memory data) = SUSHISWAP_ROUTER.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(0xbaa2abde, tokenA, tokenB, liquidity, amountAMin, amountBMin, to, block.timestamp));
    if (!success) revert();
    (amountA, amountB) = abi.decode(data, (uint256, uint256));
}

function deposit(address token, address from, address to, uint256 amount, uint256 share) external payable returns (uint256 amountOut, uint256 shareOut) {
    if (amount == 0) {
        amount = msg.value;
        IWETH(WETH).deposit{value: amount}();
    } else {
        _safeTransferFrom(token, from, address(this), amount);
    }
    (amountOut, shareOut) = _bentoDeposit(IERC20(token), address(this), to, amount);
}

function inariZushi(address to) external {
    uint256 amount = _balanceOf(SUSHI, msg.sender);
    _safeTransferFrom(SUSHI, msg.sender, address(this), amount);
    _sushiBarEnter(amount);
    _safeTransfer(XSUSHI, to, _balanceOf(XSUSHI, address(this)));
}

        _claimRewardsAndStake(msg.sender, to, amount);
    }
    
    function claimRewardsAndStakeOnBehalf(address from, address to, uint256 amount) external {
        if (msg.sender != _claimHelper) revert CALLER_NOT_CLAIM_HELPER();
        _claimRewardsAndStake(from, to, amount);
    }
    
    function _claimRewardsAndStake(address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        if (to == address(0)) to = from;
        uint256 balance = stakerRewardsToClaim[from];
        if (amount > balance) amount = balance;
        stakerRewardsToClaim[from] -= amount;
        uint256 shares = _convertToShares(amount);
        _totalSupply += shares;
        _balances[to] += shares;
        emit Staked(from, to, amount, shares);
        emit Transfer(address(0), to, shares);
    }
    
    function claimRewardsAndRedeem(address to, uint256 rewardAmount, uint256 redeemAmount) external {
        _claimRewards(msg.sender, to, rewardAmount);
        redeem(to, redeemAmount);
    }
    
    function claimRewardsAndRedeemOnBehalf(address from, address to, uint256 rewardAmount, uint256 redeemAmount) external {
        if (msg.sender != _claimHelper) revert CALLER_NOT_CLAIM_HELPER();
        _claimRewards(from, to, rewardAmount);
        redeemOnBehalf(from, to, redeemAmount);
    }
    
    function returnFunds(uint256 amount) external {
        STAKED_TOKEN.transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);
        emit FundsReturned(amount);
    }
    
    function previewRedeem(uint256 amount) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _convertToShares(amount);
    }
    
    function previewStake(uint256 amount) external view returns (uint256) {
        return (amount * getExchangeRate()) / EXCHANGE_RATE_UNIT;
    }
    
    function initialize() external {
        if (_admin != address(0)) revert();
        _admin = msg.sender;
    }
    
    function SLASH_ADMIN_ROLE() external pure returns (bytes32) {
        return bytes32(uint256(2));
    }
    
    function COOLDOWN_ADMIN_ROLE() external pure returns (bytes32) {
        return bytes32(uint256(1));
    }
    
    function CLAIM_HELPER_ROLE() external pure returns (bytes32) {
        return bytes32(uint256(3));
    }
    
    function EMISSION_MANAGER() external view returns (address) {
        return _emissionManager;
    }
    
    function REVISION() external pure returns (uint256) {
        return 1;
    }
    
    function EIP712_REVISION() external pure returns (bytes32) {
        return bytes32(uint256(1));
    }
    
    function eip712Domain() external view returns (
        bytes1 fields,
        string memory name_,
        string memory version,
        uint256 chainId,
        address verifyingContract,
        bytes32 salt,
        uint256[] memory extensions
    ) {
        fields = hex"0f";
        name_ = _name;
        version = "1";
        chainId = block.chainid;
        verifyingContract = address(this);
        salt = bytes32(0);
        extensions = new uint256[](0);
    }
    
    function configureAssets(tuple(uint128 emission, uint256 distributionEnd, address asset)[] calldata assets_) external {
        if (msg.sender != _emissionManager) revert();
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < assets_.length; i++) {
            emit AssetConfigUpdated(assets_[i].asset, assets_[i].emission);
        }
    }
    
    function ghoDebtToken() external pure returns (address) {
        return address(0);
    }
    
    function assets(address) external pure returns (address) {
        return address(0);
    }
    
    function getPowersCurrent(address user) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _balances[user];
    }
    
    function getPowerCurrent(address user, uint8) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _balances[user];
    }
}

    // Events
    event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 indexed tokenId);

    event ApprovalForAll(address indexed owner, address indexed operator, bool approved);
    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);
    event RoleGranted(bytes32 indexed role, address indexed account, address indexed sender);
    event RoleRevoked(bytes32 indexed role, address indexed account, address indexed sender);
    event KingdomMintingUpdated(uint8 indexed kingdom, bool mintingEnabled, bool whitelistMintingEnabled);
    event PricesUpdated(uint256[6] oldPrices, uint256[6] newPrices);
    event BaseUriUpdated(string oldUri, string newUri);

    // Constants
    bytes32 public constant DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE = 0x00;
    bytes32 public constant MINTER_ROLE = 0x9f2df0fed2c77648de5860a4cc508cd0818c85b8b8a1ab4ceeef8d981c8956a6;
    bytes32 public constant ROYALTY_ADJUSTER_ROLE = 0x42cc64ec4860a94ad09164ceae04e16d6b1dd40c82fba2b191377262fa45e2ae;
    bytes32 public constant BENEFICIARY_ROLE = 0xc8a41221bcd7fcf2c225f5a9265e1d4d39949d89197159d59e5f4b87b62c419e;
    bytes32 public constant PRICE_ADJUSTER_ROLE = 0x4d793ea4fc361c3665f6d9db15c38131a82a43687d22841882e4a1103dede17a;
    bytes32 public constant MINT_ENABLE_ROLE = 0xfc548fa2cc217ad5f99b5d48f888383ed2ae6ffa77f0348309fb8334f95b8da4;
    bytes32 public constant WHITELIST_ADMIN_ROLE = 0x0a1704759791c789e02e7ea2b8b48d3ffe1f2ebace5515b64b3172e658055175;
    bytes32 public constant BASEURI_ROLE = 0x9f2df0fed2c77648de5860a4cc508cd0818c85b8b8a1ab4ceeef8d981c8956a6;

    uint256 public constant START_TOKEN_ID = 1;
    uint256 public constant MIN_TIER = 1;
    uint256 public constant MAX_TIER = 6;
    uint256 public constant NUM_GENDERS = 2;
    uint256 public constant NUM_KINGDOMS = 21;
    uint256 public constant MAX_PURCHASE = 20;

    // State variables
    address private _owner;
    string private _name;
    string private _symbol;
    string private _baseURI;
    uint256 private _totalSupply;
    uint256[6] private _pricesPerTokenPerTier;
    uint256[6] private _tierQuantities;
    uint256[6] private _tierOffsets;
    uint256 private _royaltyFee = 1000; // 10%
    address private _royaltyRecipient;
    uint8 private _mintingDisabled;
    address private _whitelistSigner;

    mapping(uint256 => address) private _owners;
    mapping(address => uint256) private _balances;
    mapping(uint256 => address) private _tokenApprovals;
    mapping(address => mapping(address => bool)) private _operatorApprovals;
    mapping(bytes32 => mapping(address => uint8)) private _roles;
    mapping(uint8 => mapping(uint8 => mapping(uint256 => uint256))) private _minted;
    mapping(uint8 => bool) private _mintingEnabled;
    mapping(uint8 => bool) private _whitelistMintingEnabled;
    mapping(address => uint8) private _whitelist;
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) private _tokenKingdom;
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) private _tokenGender;
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) private _tokenTier;

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(owner() == msg.sender, "Ownable: caller is not the owner");
        _;
    }

    modifier nonReentrant() {
        require(_mintingDisabled != 2, "ReentrancyGuard: reentrant call");
        _mintingDisabled = 2;
        _;
        _mintingDisabled = 1;
    }

        _owner = msg.sender;
        _name = "Kingdom";
        _symbol = "KNG";
        _mintingDisabled = 1;

        _grantRole(MINTER_ROLE, msg.sender);
        _grantRole(WHITELIST_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender);

    }

        return _symbol;
    }

        return _baseURI;
    }

        address owner_ = _owners[tokenId];
        require(owner_ != address(0), "ERC721: invalid token ID");
        return owner_;

    }

        _transfer(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    function approve(address to, uint256 tokenId) external {
        address owner_ = _owners[tokenId];
        require(to != owner_, "ERC721: approval to current owner");
        require(msg.sender == owner_ || isApprovedForAll(owner_, msg.sender), "ERC721: approve caller is not owner nor approved for all");
        _tokenApprovals[tokenId] = to;
        emit Approval(owner_, to, tokenId);
    }

        require(_exists(tokenId), "ERC721: invalid token ID");
        return _tokenApprovals[tokenId];
    }

        require(operator != msg.sender, "ERC721: approve to caller");
        _operatorApprovals[msg.sender][operator] = approved;
        emit ApprovalForAll(msg.sender, operator, approved);
    }

    function isApprovedForAll(address owner_, address operator) external view returns (bool) {
        return _operatorApprovals[owner_][operator];
    }

        return _totalSupply;
    }

        uint256 count = 0;
        while (tokenId <= _totalSupply + START_TOKEN_ID - 1) {

                if (count == index) return tokenId;
                count++;

            tokenId++;

        return START_TOKEN_ID + index;
