    function revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) external {
        require(hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender) || msg.sender == owner(), "AccessControl: caller is not admin");
        _revokeRole(role, account);
    }

    function renounceRole(bytes32 role, address account) external {
        require(account == msg.sender, "AccessControl: can only renounce roles for self");
        _revokeRole(role, account);
    }

    // Ownable
    function owner() public view returns (address) {
        return _owner;
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "Ownable: new owner is the zero address");
        _transferOwnership(newOwner);
    }

    function renounceOwnership() external onlyOwner {
        _transferOwnership(address(0));
    }

    // Kingdom-specific functions
    function getKingdom(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(_exists(tokenId), "ERC721: invalid token ID");
        return _tokenKingdom[tokenId];
    }

    function getGender(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(_exists(tokenId), "ERC721: invalid token ID");
        return _tokenGender[tokenId];
    }

    function getTier(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(_exists(tokenId), "ERC721: invalid token ID");
        return _tokenTier[tokenId];
    }

    function minted(uint8 kingdom, uint8 gender, uint256 tier) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _minted[kingdom][gender][tier];
    }

    function mintingEnabled(uint8 kingdom) external view returns (bool) {
        return _mintingEnabled[kingdom];
    }

    function whitelistMintingEnabled(uint8 kingdom) external view returns (bool) {
        return _whitelistMintingEnabled[kingdom];
    }

    function getMintingEnabled() external view returns (bool[6] memory) {
        bool[6] memory result;
        for (uint8 i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
            result[i] = _mintingEnabled[i + 1];
        }
        return result;
    }

    function getWhitelistMintingEnabled() external view returns (bool[6] memory) {
        bool[6] memory result;
        for (uint8 i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
            result[i] = _whitelistMintingEnabled[i + 1];
        }
        return result;
    }

    function whitelist(address account) external view returns (bool) {
        return _whitelist[account] != 0;
    }

    function whitelistSigner(address account) external view returns (bool) {
        return account == _whitelistSigner;
    }

    function pricesPerTokenPerTier() external view returns (uint256[6] memory) {
        return _pricesPerTokenPerTier;
    }

    function pricePerTokenPerTier(uint256 tier) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(tier >= MIN_TIER && tier <= MAX_TIER, "Invalid tier");
        return _pricesPerTokenPerTier[tier - 1];
    }

    function tierQuantities(uint256 tier) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(tier >= MIN_TIER && tier <= MAX_TIER, "Invalid tier");
        return _tierQuantities[tier - 1];
    }

    function tierOffsets(uint256 tier) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(tier >= MIN_TIER && tier <= MAX_TIER, "Invalid tier");
        return _tierOffsets[tier - 1];
    }

    function remainingTokens() external view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 total = 0;
        for (uint8 kingdom = 1; kingdom <= NUM_KINGDOMS; kingdom++) {
            for (uint8 gender = 0; gender < NUM_GENDERS; gender++) {
                for (uint8 tier = MIN_TIER; tier <= MAX_TIER; tier++) {
                    total += _minted[kingdom][gender][tier];
                }
            }
        }
        return total;
    }

    function royaltyInfo(uint256 tokenId, uint256 salePrice) external view returns (address, uint256) {
        require(_exists(tokenId), "ERC721: invalid token ID");
        uint256 royaltyAmount = (salePrice * _royaltyFee) / 10000;
        return (_royaltyRecipient, royaltyAmount);
    }

    // Admin functions
    function setMinting(uint8 kingdom, bool enabled, bool whitelistEnabled) external {
        require(hasRole(MINT_ENABLE_ROLE, msg.sender) || hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender), "Your account is not whitelisted");
        require(kingdom >= 1 && kingdom <= NUM_KINGDOMS, "Invalid kingdom");
        _mintingEnabled[kingdom] = enabled;
        _whitelistMintingEnabled[kingdom] = whitelistEnabled;
        emit KingdomMintingUpdated(kingdom, enabled, whitelistEnabled);
    }

    function adjustPrices(uint256[6] memory newPrices) external {
        require(hasRole(PRICE_ADJUSTER_ROLE, msg.sender) || hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender), "Your account is not whitelisted");
        uint256[6] memory oldPrices = _pricesPerTokenPerTier;
        _pricesPerTokenPerTier = newPrices;
        emit PricesUpdated(oldPrices, newPrices);
    }

    function adjustBaseUri(string memory newUri) external {
        require(hasRole(BASEURI_ROLE, msg.sender) || hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender), "Your account is not whitelisted");
        string memory oldUri = _baseURI;
        _baseURI = newUri;
        emit BaseUriUpdated(oldUri, newUri);
    }

    function adjustRoyalty(address recipient, uint96 fee) external {
        require(hasRole(ROYALTY_ADJUSTER_ROLE, msg.sender) || hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender), "Your account is not whitelisted");
        _royaltyRecipient = recipient;
        _royaltyFee = fee;
    }

    function addToWhitelist(address[] memory accounts) external {
        require(hasRole(WHITELIST_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender) || hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender), "Your account is not whitelisted");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < accounts.length; i++) {
            _whitelist[accounts[i]] = 1;
        }
    }

    function removeFromWhitelist(address[] memory accounts) external {
        require(hasRole(WHITELIST_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender) || hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender), "Your account is not whitelisted");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < accounts.length; i++) {
            _whitelist[accounts[i]] = 0;
        }
    }

    function setWhitelistSigner(address[] memory accounts, bool enabled) external {
        require(hasRole(WHITELIST_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender) || hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender), "Your account is not whitelisted");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < accounts.length; i++) {
            if (enabled) {
                _whitelistSigner = accounts[i];
            }
        }
    }

    function withdraw(address to) external {
        require(hasRole(BENEFICIARY_ROLE, msg.sender) || hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender), "Your account is not whitelisted");
        uint256 balance = address(this).balance;
        require(balance > 0, "No balance");
        (bool success, ) = to.call{value: balance}("");
        require(success, "Transfer failed");
    }

    // Minting functions
    function mintFor(address to, uint256 amount, uint8 kingdom, uint8 gender, uint256 tier) external {
        require(hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, msg.sender) || hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender), "Your account is not whitelisted");
        require(kingdom >= 1 && kingdom <= NUM_KINGDOMS, "Invalid kingdom");
        require(gender < NUM_GENDERS, "Invalid gender");
        require(tier >= MIN_TIER && tier <= MAX_TIER, "Invalid tier");
        _mint(to, amount, kingdom, gender, tier);
    }

    function purchase(address to, uint256 amount, uint8 kingdom, uint256 tier) external payable nonReentrant {
        require(amount <= MAX_PURCHASE, "You can purchase a maximum of 20 NFTs");
        require(kingdom >= 1 && kingdom <= NUM_KINGDOMS, "Invalid kingdom");
        require(tier >= MIN_TIER && tier <= MAX_TIER, "Invalid tier");
        require(_mintingEnabled[kingdom], "Minting disabled for Kingdom");
        require(_whitelist[msg.sender] != 0, "Your account is not whitelisted");
        
        uint256 price = _pricesPerTokenPerTier[tier - 1] * amount;
        require(msg.value >= price, "Ether sent is not correct");
        
        _mint(to, amount, kingdom, 0, tier);
    }

    function purchaseSignedWhitelist(address to, uint256 amount, uint8 kingdom, uint256 tier, bytes memory signature) external payable nonReentrant {
        require(amount <= MAX_PURCHASE, "You can purchase a maximum of 20 NFTs");
        require(kingdom >= 1 && kingdom <= NUM_KINGDOMS, "Invalid kingdom");
        require(tier >= MIN_TIER && tier <= MAX_TIER, "Invalid tier");
        require(_mintingEnabled[kingdom], "Minting disabled for Kingdom");
        
        // Verify signature
        bytes32 hash = keccak256(abi.encodePacked("\x19Ethereum Signed Message:\n32", keccak256(abi.encodePacked(to, amount, kingdom, tier))));
        address signer = recoverSigner(hash, signature);
        require(signer == _whitelistSigner, "Your account is not whitelisted");
        
        uint256 price = _pricesPerTokenPerTier[tier - 1] * amount;
        require(msg.value >= price, "Ether sent is not correct");
        
        _mint(to, amount, kingdom, 0, tier);
    }

    // ERC165
    function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) external pure returns (bool) {
        return interfaceId == 0x01ffc9a7 || // ERC165
               interfaceId == 0x80ac58cd || // ERC721
               interfaceId == 0x5b5e139f || // ERC721Metadata
               interfaceId == 0x780e9d63;   // ERC721Enumerable
    }

    // Internal functions
    function _exists(uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {
        return _owners[tokenId] != address(0);
    }

    function _safeTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) internal {
        _transfer(from, to, tokenId);
        require(_checkOnERC721Received(from, to, tokenId, data), "ERC721: transfer to non ERC721Receiver implementer");
    }

    function _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        require(_owners[tokenId] == from, "ERC721: transfer from incorrect owner");
        require(to != address(0), "ERC721: transfer to the zero address");
        
        _tokenApprovals[tokenId] = address(0);
        _balances[from] -= 1;
        _balances[to] += 1;
        _owners[tokenId] = to;
        
        emit Transfer(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    function _mint(address to, uint256 amount, uint8 kingdom, uint8 gender, uint256 tier) internal {
        require(to != address(0), "ERC721: mint to the zero address");
        
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < amount; i++) {
            uint256 tokenId = _totalSupply + START_TOKEN_ID;
            _owners[tokenId] = to;
            _balances[to] += 1;
            _tokenKingdom[tokenId] = kingdom;
            _tokenGender[tokenId] = gender;
            _tokenTier[tokenId] = tier;
            emit Transfer(address(0), to, tokenId);
            _totalSupply++;
        }
        
        _minted[kingdom][gender][tier] += amount;
    }

    function _grantRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal {
        if (_roles[role][account] == 0) {
            _roles[role][account] = 1;
            emit RoleGranted(role, account, msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function _revokeRole(bytes32 role, address account) internal {
        if (_roles[role][account] != 0) {
            _roles[role][account] = 0;
            emit RoleRevoked(role, account, msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function _transferOwnership(address newOwner) internal {
        address oldOwner = _owner;
        _owner = newOwner;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(oldOwner, newOwner);
    }

    function _checkOnERC721Received(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) internal returns (bool) {
        if (to.code.length == 0) return true;
        
        try IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received(msg.sender, from, tokenId, data) returns (bytes4 retval) {
            return retval == IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received.selector;
        } catch (bytes memory reason) {
            if (reason.length == 0) revert("ERC721: transfer to non ERC721Receiver implementer");
            else assembly { revert(add(32, reason), mload(reason)) }
        }
    }

    function recoverSigner(bytes32 hash, bytes memory signature) internal pure returns (address) {
        require(signature.length == 65, "ECDSA: invalid signature length");
        
        bytes32 r;
        bytes32 s;
        uint8 v;
        
        assembly {
            r := mload(add(signature, 32))
            s := mload(add(signature, 64))
            v := byte(0, mload(add(signature, 96)))
        }
        
        if (v < 27) v += 27;
        require(v == 27 || v == 28, "ECDSA: invalid signature 'v' value");
        
        return ecrecover(hash, v, r, s);
    }

    function uint256ToString(uint256 value) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        if (value == 0) return "0";
        
        uint256 temp = value;
        uint256 digits;
        while (temp != 0) {
            digits++;
            temp /= 10;
        }
        
        bytes memory buffer = new bytes(digits);
        while (value != 0) {
            digits -= 1;
            buffer[digits] = bytes1(uint8(48 + (value % 10)));
            value /= 10;
        }
        
        return string(buffer);
    }
}

interface IERC721Receiver {
    function onERC721Received(address operator, address from, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) external returns (bytes4);
}

contract Ownable {
    address private _owner;

    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);

    constructor() public {
        _owner = msg.sender;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(address(0), msg.sender);
    }

    function owner() public view returns (address) {
        return _owner;
    }

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(_owner == msg.sender, "Ownable: caller is not the owner");
        _;
    }

    function renounceOwnership() public onlyOwner {
        emit OwnershipTransferred(_owner, address(0));
        _owner = address(0);
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) public onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "Ownable: new owner is the 0 address");
        emit OwnershipTransferred(_owner, newOwner);
        _owner = newOwner;
    }

    function isOwner() public view returns (bool) {
        return msg.sender == _owner;
    }
}

    function compound(address pool) external {

        return IAPR(APRAddress).getAPROptionsAdjusted(pool, amount);
    }
}
